display.name: Dev loop
display.description: Queue wait, batch formation to landing, attribute outcomes and deploys from the devloop database.

display.name: Pull-request CI queue wait
display.description: Seconds from a build's creation to its start, over each build's first attempt, per day: p50, p90 and p99.

spec.query:
SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '1 day', c."finished_at") AS "ts",
       percentile_cont(CAST(CAST(c."started_at" AS BIGINT) - CAST(c."created_at" AS BIGINT) AS DOUBLE) / 1000000.0, 0.5) AS "p50_s"
FROM "devloop"."ci_build" AS c
JOIN (SELECT "build_id", min("finished_at") AS "first_finished" FROM "devloop"."ci_build" GROUP BY "build_id") AS f
  ON c."build_id" = f."build_id" AND c."finished_at" = f."first_finished"
WHERE c."pr_number" IS NOT NULL
  AND c."started_at" IS NOT NULL
  AND c."created_at" IS NOT NULL
  AND c."finished_at" BETWEEN to_timestamp_millis($__from) AND to_timestamp_millis($__to)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '1 day', c."finished_at") AS "ts",
       percentile_cont(CAST(CAST(c."started_at" AS BIGINT) - CAST(c."created_at" AS BIGINT) AS DOUBLE) / 1000000.0, 0.9) AS "p90_s"
FROM "devloop"."ci_build" AS c
JOIN (SELECT "build_id", min("finished_at") AS "first_finished" FROM "devloop"."ci_build" GROUP BY "build_id") AS f
  ON c."build_id" = f."build_id" AND c."finished_at" = f."first_finished"
WHERE c."pr_number" IS NOT NULL
  AND c."started_at" IS NOT NULL
  AND c."created_at" IS NOT NULL
  AND c."finished_at" BETWEEN to_timestamp_millis($__from) AND to_timestamp_millis($__to)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '1 day', c."finished_at") AS "ts",
       percentile_cont(CAST(CAST(c."started_at" AS BIGINT) - CAST(c."created_at" AS BIGINT) AS DOUBLE) / 1000000.0, 0.99) AS "p99_s"
FROM "devloop"."ci_build" AS c
JOIN (SELECT "build_id", min("finished_at") AS "first_finished" FROM "devloop"."ci_build" GROUP BY "build_id") AS f
  ON c."build_id" = f."build_id" AND c."finished_at" = f."first_finished"
WHERE c."pr_number" IS NOT NULL
  AND c."started_at" IS NOT NULL
  AND c."created_at" IS NOT NULL
  AND c."finished_at" BETWEEN to_timestamp_millis($__from) AND to_timestamp_millis($__to)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

display.name: Batch formation to landing
display.description: Seconds from a merge-queue batch's formation to its completion, at completion.

spec.query:
SELECT d."ts" AS "ts",
       CAST(CAST(d."ts" AS BIGINT) - CAST(f."ts" AS BIGINT) AS DOUBLE) / 1000000.0 AS "formation_to_land_s"
FROM "devloop"."batch_event" AS f
JOIN "devloop"."batch_event" AS d ON d."batch" = f."batch"
WHERE f."msg" = 'batch formed'
  AND d."msg" = 'batch done'
  AND d."ts" BETWEEN to_timestamp_millis($__from) AND to_timestamp_millis($__to)
ORDER BY 1

display.name: Attribute outcomes per day
display.description: Evaluated attributes per day by nixbot status.

spec.query:
SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '1 day', "finished_at") AS "ts",
       count(*) AS "attributes",
       "status" AS "status"
FROM "devloop"."ci_attribute"
WHERE "finished_at" BETWEEN to_timestamp_millis($__from) AND to_timestamp_millis($__to)
GROUP BY 1, 3
ORDER BY 1

display.name: Deploys
display.description: One point per recorded deploy, by host.

spec.query:
SELECT "ts" AS "ts",
       1 AS "n",
       "host" AS "host"
FROM "devloop"."deploy_record"
WHERE "ts" BETWEEN to_timestamp_millis($__from) AND to_timestamp_millis($__to)
ORDER BY 1
